alt.en: A woman in layered red and green robes raises a patterned bamboo blind; a snow-covered garden appears below.
alt.zh: 身穿红绿叠衣的女子卷起带花纹的竹帘，下方可见积雪庭园。

caption.en: The Court Lady Sei Shōnagon, by Tosa Mitsuoki (1617–1691); Edo period, seventeenth century. Color on silk, Tokyo National Museum A-952.
caption.zh: 《清少纳言图》，土佐光起（1617—1691）绘；江户时代、十七世纪。绢本设色，东京国立博物馆A-952。

interpretation.en: The Japanese catalogue identifies a Pillow Book episode: asked about snow on Incense-Burner Peak, Sei raises the blind in response to a poetic allusion. The painting transforms literary wit into a gesture, centuries after the author’s life.
interpretation.zh: 日文馆藏说明将画面认作《枕草子》中“香炉峰之雪”的段落：清少纳言卷帘回应诗意问话。作者生活数百年后，绘画把文学机智转为一个动作。
